name: Chambre des Représentants
notes: House of Representatives after the 23 September 2026 election; final distribution announced by the Interior Ministry on 25 September 2026. The Chamber's own member list (chambredesrepresentants.ma) refuses automated access
column10: so who sits is read from press reports of the constituency results

name: Chambre des Conseillers
notes: House of Councillors of Morocco (120 seats, indirectly elected). Not charted: the Chamber's page on its groups (2021-2027) names eight groups, three smaller groups and two unaffiliated members but gives no member counts, and no machine-readable member list with affiliations was found, so a chart would be invented. Several groups are trade unions, not parties.
